new_value: Fixed: TrustStorePersistence.load() now fails closed on corrupt/tampered files, validates all fields (hex, lengths, derivation bindings, duplicates, types, bounds), and returns None only for missing files. Tests added for corrupt JSON, invalid hex, wrong lengths, pubkey/iid mismatch, duplicate IIDs, invalid trust level, negative timestamps. All tests pass, ruff clean.
